::: {.home-intro}
I'm a statistician from Cali, Colombia. I like data that moves through time, and most of what I know is about reasoning with it: state-space models, Kalman filters and honest uncertainty.

I spent five years at CIAT modelling climate and crops, then moved to industry machine learning. I currently work as an AI engineer. This site is where I write down what I learn, with code in R and Python.
